overrides.reason: ZLAQR4 caps its aggressive-early-deflation window at NW <= LWORK/2 and its simultaneous shifts at NS <= 2*LWORK/3, and ZLAQR2 and ZLAQR5 then pick their block sizes from the WORK they are given, so the reference's own QR iteration depends on LWORK: below its documented max(1,N) (which it neither checks nor needs) it is accepted but takes another path, and at LWORK = 1 or 2 (no window, no shifts) it makes no progress and returns INFO = IHI with H and Z partly reduced. Compiled LAPACK 3.12.0 does this too: N = 120 and 140 (the cyclic shift and a random Hessenberg matrix) at LWORK = 1, 2 return INFO = N, at LWORK = 3 INFO = 0 (N = 120 cyclic shift and N = 140 random), at LWORK >= 4 INFO = 0, never writing past WORK(LWORK). The Schur form and vectors are unique only up to the order and signs the path picks. The module's tests check LWORK = 1 (INFO = N, as the reference) and a few elements past the blocking threshold (all eigenvalues found) (ticket 0016).
